Before an affix having an initial vowel, which causes reduplication, the substitute which takes the place of a vowel is like the original vowel even in form, only for the purpose of reduplication and no further.

Terms:

And the compound called द्विगु (Numeral Determinative Compound) is all called तत्-पुरुष ।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

A word ending in a 2nd case-affix is compounded with the words श्रित 'who had recourse to', अतीत 'gone by', पतित 'who has fallen upon', गत 'who has gone to', अत्यस्त 'who has passed', प्राप्त 'who has obtained' and अपान्न 'who has reached' and the resulting compound is called तत्-पुरुष ।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

The words द्वितीय 'second', तृतीय 'third', चतुर्थ 'fourth', तुर्य 'fourth', are optionally compounded with that word which signifies a thing that has parts, provided that the thing having parts is distinguished numerically by unity. The compound so formed is called तत्-पुरुष।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

The object of the verb दिव् when having the above-mentioned sense of 'dealing' or 'stalking', takes the 2nd case, in the ब्राह्मण literature.

Terms: विभक्ति-2

All affixes after the verb गाङ् 'to study' and the verb कुट् 'to be crooked' and the rest, are as if they had an indicatory ङ् (ङित्), except those affixes which have an indicatory ञ् (ञित्) or ण् (णित्).

Terms:

When an affix of the Accusative -2nd case or टा - Instrumental -3rd case singular or ओश् Locative -7th-case dual follows, एन् which is अनुदात्त is the substitute of इदम् and its re-employment.

Terms: समास

The affix खच् comes after the verb ताप् 'to heat' when द्विषत् or पर is the word in composition with it as an object.

Terms: खच्

The affix शतृ comes after the verb द्विष् when the agent indicated means 'an enemy'.

Terms: शतृ

The affix णमुल् is added to the root when a word in the Accusative -2nd case is in composition and when 'haste' is intended.

Terms: णमुल्

आ is substituted for the final of युष्मद् and अस्मद् before the case-ending of the Accusative -2nd case.

Terms: सर्वनाम युष्मद्- अस्मद्

In the opinion of शाकटायन only जुस् is the substitute of झि , in the लङ् (Imperfect Tense) after the verb द्विष् 'to hate'.

Terms: झि

The affix ङीप् come in the feminine after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) ending in अ , which is द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound). 

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीप्

A तद्धित affix ordained to come on account of the relation of the words being that of a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) is elided by लुक् when it has the sense of the various affixes taught antecedent to तेन दीव्यति खनति जयति जितम्

etc., but not so, the affix having the sense of a गोत्र (Patronymic).

Terms: तद्धित

The affix यञ् comes in the remaining senses after the word द्वीप , which is near the sea.

Terms: यञ्
The आर्हीय affix

is optionally elided after a द्विगु occasioning compound, of the word निष्क preceded by द्वि and त्रि।

Terms:
The affix अण् (-/- -अ) as well as यत् optionally also comes after the word शाण , in the आर्हीय-senses

-63, when preced by the words द्वि and त्रि।

Terms:

The affix ष्ठान् (-/- इक) as well as the affix affix ख (ईन) may optionally come after the same words आढक, आचित and पात्र being final of a द्विगु compound, the sense being that of 'what can hold etc.'.

Terms:

The affix यप् comes after the word मास when forming a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) and meaning 'age'.

Terms: यप्
The affix ख (ईन) comes optionally in the senses taught in पन्थो ण नित्यम्
, तमधीष्टो भृतो भूतो भावी

after the word समा , forming a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound).

Terms: ख

The affix अयच् is optionally the substitute of तयप्‌ after the words 1. द्वि and 2. त्रि।

Terms: अयच्

The substitute धमुञ् comes optionally in the place of धा after the words 1. द्वि and 2. त्रि।

Terms: धमुञ्

The affixes तरप् (तर) and ईयसुन् (ईयस्) come in the sense of 'surpassing' after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) or a finite-verb when it expresses (comparison between) two things or when that which is added to it (उपपद) is to be distinguished from another.

Terms: तरप् (तर) and ईयसुन् (ईयस्)

The affix सुच् (स्) is added to the numerals 1. द्वि 2. त्रि and 3. चतुर् in the sense of counting the repetition of an action.

Terms: सुच् (स्)

The words 1. द्विस्तावा and 2.त्रिस्तावा are irregularly formed meaning a वेदि 'altar'.

Terms: Irregular

The affix टच् is added to the word अञ्जलि when preceded by 1. द्वि or 2. त्रि in a द्विगु तत्-पुरुष समास (Numeral Determinative Compound).

Terms: टच्

The affix ष comes after a बहुव्रीहि समास ending in मूर्ध्न् and preceded by 1. द्वि and 2. त्रि।

Terms: ष

The words द्विदण्डि etc. are valid forms of इच्।

Terms: इच्

The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) denoting 'measure or quantity'.

Terms: तत्-पुरुष समास

Before a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound), when the compound denotes a sacrifice, the last syllable of the first member has the acute accent (उदात्त).

Terms: समास end acute-1st-term

In a बहुव्रीहि समास the words 1. पाद् 2. दत् and 3. मूर्धन् have optionally acute accent (उदात्त) on the final after द्वि and त्रि।

Terms:

स is substituted for सह when it is in connection with a word which refers to a second object which latter however is not directly perceived.

Terms: स Substitute

ष् is optionally the substitute of the विसर्ग of 1. द्विस् 2. त्रिस् and 3. चतुर् when they are used as numeral adverbs (before a hard guttural or a labial).

Terms: विसर्ग सन्धि
